records.name: TypeScript
records.run_instructions: With TypeScript and Node.js installed, run tsc --strict --target ES2022 hello.ts from a directory without tsconfig.json, then node hello.js. For a standalone file inside a configured project with TypeScript 6 or later, add --ignoreConfig; use tsc -p for the project's own configuration.
records.expected_result: Prints PLLDN followed by a newline.
